title: Which route has the largest bottleneck?
hook: A route has a narrow edge. Can its wider edges compensate?

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Maximize the minimum edge capacity along a path using a max-priority frontier.

misconception: The route with the largest total capacity also carries the largest bottleneck load.
objective: Maximize the minimum edge capacity along a path using a max-priority frontier.

claims.text: A max-priority frontier optimizes minimum edge capacity rather than summed cost.
